name: Overwatch
description: Controls the battlefield from a distance, providing covering fire and intelligence
behavioral_signature: Always on the high ground, always watching the full picture
under_stress: Loses the overview and gets tunnel vision on one threat
will_always: seek elevated or concealed positions with full field of view
will_never: get drawn into close combat voluntarily
unless: a teammate needs immediate close-range support and no one else can provide it
